第 44 章 How to Share Decisions for Strong Execution如何分享决策以强执行

Katie Womersley / 凯蒂·沃姆斯利

— 第 131 页 —

There's a lot of great research on how to make good decisions, more decisions, and faster decisions. But as a manager, getting the decisions made (well, fast, and by the appropriate people) is just the first step. You also need to make sure that these decisions are acted upon. This means that they need to be clearly understood, shared with the proper people, and can be easily referenced.

关于如何做好决策、更多决策、更快决策有很多好研究。但作为经理，让决策被做出来（好、快、由合适的人做）只是第一步。你还需要确保这些决策被执行。这意味着它们需要被清楚理解、分享给合适的人、并且可以轻松引用。

Being intentional about sharing decisions increases the quality of your team's decision making and builds stronger alignment across your team. Clearly communicating decisions is vital for a team to execute those decisions, yet many leaders struggle to do this effectively. Following are four methods that you can consider to help you sharpen your communications with your team:

有意识地分享决策能提高团队决策质量、建立更强的团队对齐。清楚地沟通决策对团队执行决策至关重要，但很多领导者难以有效做到。以下是四个方法可以帮你加强和团队的沟通：

  1. Clarify the decision. To make and communicate decisions effectively, you need a very clear statement of what the decision is. Don't skip this step! If you've ever been in a meeting and thought, "Wait…what are we deciding?" everyone's time is getting wasted.澄清决策。要有效做和沟通决策，你需要一个非常清楚的决策陈述。不要跳过这步！如果你曾经在会议上想「等等……我们在决定什么？」那大家的时间都在浪费。
— 第 132 页 —

Share that the decision making is happening. For bigger decisions, it's helpful to share ahead what decision is being made. This can be lightweight and quick—a point on a meeting agenda (make sure to share your meeting notes) or a quick email. Knowing ahead of time that a certain decision will be on the agenda helps people to arrive prepared and gather their thoughts. Advance notice also helps include those more thoughtful, deliberate teammates who prefer not to think on their feet. You'll get more varied perspectives and a better-quality decision.

分享决策正在进行中。对于更大的决策，提前分享正在做什么决策是有帮助的。这可以轻量快速——会议议程上的一个点（确保分享会议笔记）或一封快速邮件。提前知道某个决策在议程上帮人们带着准备和整理好的思路来。提前通知还有助于包括那些更喜欢深思熟虑、不喜欢临场思考的队友。你会得到更多样的视角和更好质量的决策。

Decide and share who the decision makers are. For a simple decision, it's helpful to identify who the decision maker is: the person who will make the decision (and be accountable to the outcomes). For a more complex decision, doing a RACI responsibility assignment matrix works well. The "responsible" person, or decision maker, should also be communicating the decision. If it's unclear who will make the decision, you can end up with a bystander effect in which everyone participates in the decision, but no one takes ownership of (1) ensuring a decision is reached and (2) communicating the decision.

决定并分享谁是决策者。对于简单决策，识别谁是决策者很有帮助：做决策（并对结果负责）的人。对于更复杂的决策，做 RACI 责任分配矩阵很有效。「负责」的人或决策者也应该是沟通决策的人。如果不清楚谁做决策，你可能最终遇到旁观者效应——每个人都参与决策，但没有人拥有（1）确保决策达成和（2）沟通决策的责任。

Bonus points if this person isn't (always) the manager. Effectively delegating decision making is a necessary step for building a strong, autonomous, empowered team.

加分项是这个人不（总是）是经理。有效授权决策是建设强大、自主、赋能团队的必要步骤。

— 第 133 页 —

Document the decision. After your decision is made, in whatever format you're using, you need to ensure two things: your decision is communicated, and there's a record of that decision that can be accessed later. To share the content of a decision, choose a communication method that's lower volume and more persistent. For example, email works better than throwing a key decision into a fast-moving group chat channel. Having a document like a Google Docs or Dropbox Paper to record what the decision is and who the decision makers were is helpful to reference later on, too.

记录决策。决策做出后，无论你用什么格式，你需要确保两件事：决策被沟通了，并且有一个决策记录以后可以访问。要分享决策内容，选择一个更低频、更持久的沟通方式。例如，邮件比把关键决策扔进快速流动的群聊频道更好。有一个 Google Docs 或 Dropbox Paper 这样的文档记录决策是什么、谁是决策者，以后参考也有帮助。

The decision should be shared to the widest group of people whom it might affect. A decision that directly affects product engineers but could be of interest to engineers outside product engineering (e.g., a DevOps team) might be shared to all engineers. For bigger decisions, by the time you're at this stage, people should not be hearing about the decision out of the blue. They should have already heard that the decision is being made, why, and by whom. They might have even seen that decision be made in a meeting or followed along in your document. This is important so that by the time the decision is shared in a follow-up communication, it's much easier to process and retain. Don't surprise people.

决策应该分享给可能受影响的最广人群。一个直接影响产品工程师但产品工程外的工程师（如 DevOps 团队）可能感兴趣的决策，可以分享给所有工程师。对于更大的决策，到这个阶段时，人们不应该突然听到决策。他们应该已经听说正在做决策、为什么、由谁做。他们甚至可能在会议上看到决策被做出或在你的文档中跟进。这很重要，这样当决策在后续沟通中分享时，更容易处理和记住。不要让人意外。

Finally, you need to record the decision. Do any documents or workflows need to change? If so, update them promptly. Will this affect how teams work going forward? If yes, you'll need to update your team handbook/wiki. Do you just need a record that is a bit more accessible than email? It's handy to share your Dropbox Paper/Google Drive doc, put it in an appropriate folder, and link to that in a team "what happened this week" roundup. If you're not doing these things and you sense that your team could be more on the same page, this might be what's missing.

最后，你需要记录决策。有文档或工作流需要改变吗？如果有，及时更新。这会影响团队未来的工作方式吗？如果会，你需要更新团队手册/wiki。你只需要一个比邮件更容易访问的记录吗？分享你的 Dropbox Paper/Google Drive 文档，放在合适的文件夹里，在团队「本周发生了什么」汇总中链接它。如果你没在做这些事，感觉团队可以更对齐，这可能就是缺失的部分。

But This All Takes So…Tediously…Long. Yes, it does. But it's tremendously less time and effort than your team not know what's going on. Constantly putting out fires, redoing work, and repairing relationships because people weren't on the same page is far more time consuming than communicating intentionally. A team that all rows in the same direction gets there faster.

但这一切太……费时间了。是的，确实。但这比你的团队不知道在发生什么省时间省精力多了。因为人们不对齐而不断救火、返工、修复关系，比有意识地沟通耗时得多。一个朝同一方向划桨的团队到得更快。
